==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will attempt to cast and maintain this enchantment on any [[party]] member wielding a melee weapon, as long as they have at least 2 [[pip]]s of energy regeneration. When at 2 pips, they will cast additional copies, but stop maintaining one immediately after.
** If a player switches to a ranged weapon, they will stop maintaining it.

==Notes==
*The additional damage is [[armor-ignoring]], so a character without the [[Requirement|required]] [[attribute]] rank for their melee [[weapon]] will still deal Strength of Honor's damage.
* More than one monk can maintain this enchantment on a target but the effects will not stack.
